license_summary: Per resource: icon sets MIT/ISC, illustrations with custom terms, paid kits proprietary. See each entry.
granularity: curated: icon sets, illustrations, design-tool libraries and paid UI kits (reference level)

extraction.method: Hand-curated list; license evidence linked in manual_steps

entries.name: Canva
entries.description: Drag-and-drop design tool with templates, graphics, photos and video for marketing visuals, social posts and presentations.
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Good for campaign graphics and social images, not for UI components or product screens
entries.limits: Canva Content License Agreement: free and Pro content can be used commercially in your designs, but not resold as standalone assets, and Branded/Disney content is restricted to personal use. Check people, logos and trademarks in images.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Heroicons
entries.description: Hand-crafted SVG icons from the makers of Tailwind CSS (324 outline icons in the repo tree; outline, solid, mini and micro styles).
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Small, consistent set; best with Tailwind projects that need a few dozen icons
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Lucide Icons
entries.description: Open-source SVG icon set (1,866 icons in the repo tree) with official packages for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and more; the default icon set of shadcn/ui.
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Pick one icon set per project; Lucide is the shadcn default (stroke 2px, 24px grid)
entries.limits: ISC license (Lucide) with portions MIT from Feather; both permissive, keep the copyright notice.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Phosphor Icons
entries.description: Flexible icon family (1,512 icons, each in six weights: thin, light, regular, bold, fill, duotone) with official React, Vue and Svelte packages.
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Choose Phosphor when you need weight variants or duotone to express hierarchy
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Storyset
entries.description: Customizable and animated illustration collections (Freepik) with a style, color and animation editor.
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Plan for the attribution line in the footer or credits page, or budget the subscription
entries.limits: Free use requires crediting Storyset/Freepik; removing attribution needs a Flaticon Premium subscription. Reselling, sublicensing and stock-collection use are prohibited. Read the terms before commercial use.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Tabler Icons
entries.description: Large free SVG icon set (5,166 outline icons in the repo tree, plus filled variants) with packages for React, Vue, Svelte and webfonts.
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Widest coverage of niche icons; consistent 24px / 2px stroke
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: unDraw
entries.description: Open-source style SVG illustrations with an on-site color picker, free for commercial use without attribution.
entries.use_case: Add icons, illustrations or design kits that keep the visual language consistent.
decision_hints: Recolor to the project accent token; avoid using as the main brand visual (very recognizable)
entries.limits: Own license: commercial use allowed with no attribution; you may not redistribute illustrations in packs, scrape or embed them without consent, sell them as your product, or use them to train AI/ML models.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Flowbite Blocks
entries.description: Tailwind CSS sections for marketing, application, e-commerce and publisher pages (hero, pricing, contact, dashboards); a free subset under MIT and a larger Pro collection.
entries.use_case: Compose complete page sections that combine several components.
decision_hints: Pair with the Flowbite component source (`--source flowbite`)
entries.limits: Only the free blocks are MIT; the full collection (Pro, with Figma files) is paid and not indexed. Check the block page for the Pro badge.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Tailwind Plus (UI Blocks, Templates, Catalyst)
entries.description: Official Tailwind Labs library of 500+ polished UI blocks, site templates and the Catalyst application UI kit; paid one-time license.
entries.use_case: Compose complete page sections that combine several components.
decision_hints: Highest visual polish of the Tailwind options; only recommend if the user has or will buy a license
Never copy its code into the kit or a public repo
entries.limits: Paid: Personal license $299 one-time (Team $979; single packages $149 at the time of checking). Allowed in your own and client projects as the license permits; redistribution of the code is not allowed. Verify current prices.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Figma Community
entries.description: Community-published Figma files: UI kits, design systems, icon libraries and templates (for example the free edition of the Flowbite design system).
entries.use_case: Reference a full design system for tokens, components and theming guidance.
decision_hints: Use as a visual and structural reference or starting kit; export tokens into DESIGN.md
Credit CC BY files in the project credits
entries.limits: Free community files are published under CC BY 4.0 (commercial use allowed, credit the creator); paid files use the Community Paid Resource License. The license is per file: always check the file page.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.

entries.name: Untitled UI React
entries.description: Large React component library built on Tailwind CSS and React Aria with a free MIT tier (base components, hundreds of application UI components and marketing sections) and a PRO tier.
entries.use_case: Reference a full design system for tokens, components and theming guidance.
decision_hints: Check each component page for the Free/PRO badge before adopting
Closest drop-in alternative to shadcn/ui with a stronger visual system
entries.limits: Free components are MIT. PRO (from $349) adds more components, 250+ page examples and Figma sync and requires `npx untitledui@latest login`; PRO code is not MIT.
entries.extraction_note: Hand-curated on 2026-10-04: license facts checked against the linked evidence; no machine-readable registry exists.
